note: 太田・入沢・陣山・栄町 (north of the inner bay). Roof colours: the median roof colour per lot on Google Earth top views (imagery 2026-03-11) at ~0.32 m/px (raw/ref/earth/c2/sub/<block>/earth_top.png, registered per block and per lot), with NO grading applied (sys:1: the colour is the raw sub-cell Earth median, 'earth' per lot in raw/ref/earth/c2/tools/roofplan.json, as c9 and c10 do; the first pass divided each channel by a per-channel cast (the median Earth/app roof ratio 0.839, 0.598, 0.671, not the asphalt gain 1/0.90, 1/0.82, 1/0.80 this note used to name), which lifted green and blue over red and gave 70 pale mint roofs where Earth shows grey and brown ones); applied where it differs from the app by dE2000 >= 10. Everything else is hand-read from the Earth views and cited per entry.
